title: Clear, standalone privacy notice before or at collection
description: Unbundled, itemized notice detailing personal data categories, specific purposes, rights exercise, and Data Protection Board of India complaint procedure.

title: Unticked, granular, separate consent choices
description: Explicit separate checkboxes for essential, order updates, marketing, and analytics; no pre-ticked boxes or forced bundling with Terms of Service.

title: Non-conditional service access
description: App remains fully functional for ordering groceries even when optional marketing and analytics consents are declined.
verification: backend/src/middleware/dpdpMiddleware.js and order checkout without marketing consent

title: Auditable, tamper-evident consent ledger
description: Stores user ID, granular purpose, notice version, timestamp, channel, and IP hash with append-only audit trail.

title: Frictionless consent withdrawal
description: Profile settings provide one-click toggle to revoke consent, taking immediate effect and halting downstream processing.

title: Multi-language notice & consent (Eighth Schedule languages)
description: Notice and consent available in English, Hindi (हिन्दी), Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ), Tamil (தமிழ்), Telugu (తెలుగు), and Bengali (বাংলা).

title: Purpose limitation and purpose tagging on data fields
description: Personal data fields tagged with allowed purposes; runtime check prevents using personal data for non-consented purposes.

title: Standard Consent Manager integration interface
description: Documented and mocked API interface allowing registered Consent Managers to query and update user consent state.

title: Reasonable security safeguards against breach
description: Full suite of OWASP A01-A10 and additional technical controls mapped to DPDP reasonable security safeguards.
verification: groundtruth/controls.json all controls mapped with dpdp_relevant: true

title: Breach notification protocol and incident runbook
description: Incident response runbook and automated templates for intimation to Data Protection Board of India and affected users within required timeframe.

title: Automated data retention schedule and purge job
description: Retention limits defined per category; automated cron/worker purges expired sessions, temp uploads, and old inactive records.

title: Data accuracy and self-service correction flow
description: Input validation ensures data quality; authenticated self-service profile update enables immediate corrections.

title: Data processor register and minimised sharing
description: Register of all third-party processors (payment, logistics, SMS) with DPA reference, purpose, and minimised shared fields.

title: Prominently published DPO and business contact info
description: Data Protection Officer / Grievance Officer contact details displayed in privacy notice, footer, and privacy policy.

title: In-app grievance redressal mechanism with Board escalation path
description: Ticketed grievance filing, automated acknowledgement, 72-hour SLA tracker, and transparent escalation link to the DPBI.

title: Right to Access: comprehensive 'Download My Data' export
description: Machine-readable JSON export of user profile, orders, locations, consent history, support tickets, and list of processors shared with.

title: Right to Erasure: true cryptographic erasure across tables and caches
description: Irreversible anonymization/deletion of personal data while preserving only statutory tax/order invoice summaries with personal data expunged.

title: Right to Correction and updating of inaccurate data
description: Self-service updating of personal info with audit logging of previous vs updated state.

title: Right of Nomination: designate representative
description: Allows data principals to nominate an individual to exercise their rights in event of death or incapacity.

title: Children's data: age gating and verifiable parental consent
description: Users under 18 years flagged as minors; processing gated behind verifiable parental consent flow with parent verification token.

title: Prohibition of tracking, profiling, and targeted ads for minors
description: Server-side and client-side hard lockout of analytics, telemetry, and promotional targeting for minor accounts.

title: Cross-border transfer restrictions: Indian territory processing
description: Primary data stored and processed in India-based endpoints; transfer allowlist strictly verified against notified countries.

title: Significant Data Fiduciary (SDF) governance readiness
description: Config toggle and artefacts for SDF requirements: appointed DPO, independent data auditor, DPIA summary, algorithmic transparency.

title: Zero personal data in URLs, query strings, and telemetry payloads
description: Guaranteed absence of emails, phone numbers, or tokens in query parameters, error reports, and client URLs.
verification: Automated route and query inspection test

title: Comprehensive Record of Processing Activities (RoPA)
description: Live maintained inventory documenting data fields, legal grounds, storage locations, retention schedules, and security measures.
